parameters.name: DstIp
parameters.description: The destination IP address. This is an optional parameter used to filter by destination IP address.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the query (UNIX timestamp in seconds). This parameter is required. If this parameter is not specified, the API returns an error.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- **zh** (default): Chinese.
- **en**: English.

parameters.name: SensitiveCategory
parameters.description: The type of sensitive credential. This parameter is required. If this parameter is not specified, the API returns an error.

parameters.name: SrcIp
parameters.description: The source IP address. This is an optional parameter used to filter by source IP address.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the query (UNIX timestamp in seconds). This parameter is required. If this parameter is not specified, the API returns an error.
